subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: Is the approved boundary for this E2E workflow a locally built repository recipe, or may it consume a separately published image and, if so, what repository-controlled provenance verification is required?
rationale: The patch supplies a useful base recipe and a digest-pinned published image, but choosing the acceptable producer and attestation boundary for code that runs on the CI executor is a security policy decision rather than a mechanical review preference.

options.title: Build the base in the workflow
options.body: Build and tag `Dockerfile.base` from the checked-out revision before building or running the E2E image, so the executed base is directly reviewable in this repository.

options.title: Adopt an attested published base
options.body: Keep a published base only after maintainers define and implement repository-controlled publishing, ownership, signing or attestation, and verification in the consuming workflow.

options.title: Pause the container workflow
options.body: Keep the local harness but defer the Blacksmith E2E workflow until a durable image-provenance policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Build the base in the workflow
recommendation.body: Build and tag `Dockerfile.base` from the checked-out revision before building or running the E2E image, so the executed base is directly reviewable in this repository.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available contributor connected to the current harness and can apply the selected provenance direction, subject to maintainer security-policy approval.
